records.title: Structure Ragoogle as a DDD hexagonal monorepo
records.summary: We will structure the platform as a monorepo of deployable apps over a set of bounded contexts, each context following ports-and-adapters (hexagonal) layering.

records.title: Use Voyage voyage-3-large as the default embedding model
records.summary: We will use **Voyage `voyage-3-large` at 1024 dimensions** as the default embedding model, behind an `EmbeddingProvider` port with adapters for all four candidates.

records.title: Support both service-account and OAuth authentication for Google Drive
records.summary: We will support **both modes, selectable per document source** in the configuration area, behind a single `SourceCredential` port.

records.title: Hybrid dense/BM25 retrieval fused with RRF and a cross-encoder rerank
Provision Ragoogle with Terraform across Azure, AWS and GCP
records.summary: We will write Terraform as a set of **cloud-agnostic root modules over per-cloud implementation modules**, with a shared contract each cloud must satisfy: managed Postgres with the `vector` extension, a container runtime for the API and frontend, a KMS-backed key for credential envelope encryption (see [ADR-0003](0003-dual-mode-google-drive-authentication.md)), an object store for raw document snapshots, and an OTLP-compatible telemetry sink.

records.title: Enforce a conventional-commit auto-commit hook and ADR-as-code
records.summary: We will treat both as automation rather than discipline.
